metas.name: Des
metas.description: The story of one of the most infamous cases in UK criminal history, that of serial killer Dennis Nilsen. Told through the prism of three men, the series explores the personal and professional consequences of coming into contact with a man like Nilsen.

metas.name: Seduced: Inside the NXIVM Cult
metas.description: This four-part documentary series follows the story of India Oxenberg's perilous journey through the dark and criminal world of the notorious self-help-group-turned-sex-slave-cult NXIVM.

metas.name: The Yogurt Shop Murders
metas.description: In 1991, four teenage girls were brutally murdered at a frozen yogurt shop in Austin, Texas. What happened that night forever shook the Austin community and continues to mystify the police and haunt the families left in the wake of unthinkable loss.

metas.name: One of Us Is Lying
metas.description: The story of what happens when five high schoolers walk into detention and only four make it out alive. Everyone is a suspect, and everyone has something to hide.

metas.name: Guillermo del Toro's Cabinet of Curiosities
metas.description: Bizarre nightmares unfold in eight tales of terror in this visually stunning, spine-tingling horror collection curated by Guillermo del Toro.

metas.name: Stolen Youth: Inside the Cult at Sarah Lawrence
metas.description: A group of bright Sarah Lawrence College students fall under the dark influence of a friend's father, Larry Ray. With unprecedented access to the survivors who lived with Ray, the series follows the cult from its origins through its still-unfolding aftermath.

metas.name: I Just Killed My Dad
metas.description: Anthony Templet shot his father and never denied it. But why he did it is a complex question with profound implications. Explore Anthony's psyche prior to the events of June 3, 2019 and the journey of his mental and emotional aftermath.

metas.name: Conversations with a Killer: The John Wayne Gacy Tapes
metas.description: He dined with the powerful. He preyed on the vulnerable. Beneath a smiling exterior was the horrifying darkness of a sadistic serial killer.

metas.name: The Patient
metas.description: A psychotherapist finds himself held prisoner by a serial killer with an unusual request: curb his homicidal urges.

metas.name: Worst Neighbor Ever
metas.description: This intense documentary series details true stories of neighbors gone bad, from heinous fraud schemes to senseless acts of violent retribution.

metas.name: The Walking Dead: The Ones Who Live
metas.description: Rick and Michonne are thrown into another world, built on a war against the dead... And ultimately, a war against the living. Can they find each other and who they were in a place and situation unlike any they've ever known before? Are they enemies? Lovers? Victims? Victors? Without each other, are they even alive – or will they find that they, too, are the Walking Dead?

metas.name: Teacup
metas.description: A mysterious event traps people on a rural Georgia farm, forcing them to unite against an unknown, deadly force. A young boy named Arlo becomes central to uncovering the truth.

metas.name: The Body
metas.description: On Halloween night, an all-girls dance squad tumbles into Catholic guilt, unholy desires and ghostly visions when an initiation goes to hell.

metas.name: The Stand
metas.description: In a world mostly wiped out by the plague and embroiled in an elemental struggle between good and evil, the fate of mankind rests on the frail shoulders of the 108-year-old Mother Abagail and a handful of survivors. Their worst nightmares are embodied in a man with a lethal smile and unspeakable powers: Randall Flagg, the Dark Man.

metas.name: This Is the Zodiac Speaking
metas.description: In this true-crime docuseries, a family searching for answers shares clues and eye-opening testimonies about the prime suspect in the Zodiac murders.

metas.name: Gone Girls: The Long Island Serial Killer
metas.description: This tense true-crime series examines the hunt for the Long Island serial killer through the perspective of his victims, their loved ones and the police.

metas.name: American Murder: Gabby Petito
metas.description: What happened in the final days of Gabby Petito's life? In this gripping true-crime series, her loved ones reveal the untold story of her tragic murder.

metas.name: Heist
metas.description: Millions in stolen cash. Missing luxury bourbon. Watch ordinary people almost get away with these extraordinary heists in this true crime series.

metas.name: Conversations with a Killer: The Son of Sam Tapes
metas.description: Mixing present-day interviews with previously unheard recordings, this true-crime series examines serial killer David Berkowitz's mark on 1970s New York.

metas.name: Mind Over Murder
metas.description: Chronicles the bizarre and psychologically complex story of six individuals who were convicted for the 1985 murder of a beloved 68- year-old grandmother, Helen Wilson, in Beatrice, Nebraska.
